sql_templates.name: find_vcp_breakouts
sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
                p.symbol, 
                p.company_name, 
                p.sector, 
                p.live_price, 
                p.vcp_score, 
                p.vcp_breakout_pct, 
                p.fundamental_score,
                p.enhanced_fund_score, 
                p.institutional_backing 
            FROM 
                scores.stage2_vcp_picks p 
            WHERE 
                p.live_price > p.price AND
                (p.vcp_breakout_pct > 10 OR p.fundamental_score > 75) 
            ORDER BY 
                p.vcp_score DESC

synthesis_guidance: Focus on identifying high-potential breakouts with strong fundamentals; use scores to highlight potential candidates.
